-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.MemstorageApi` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def memStorInv (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) : IProp GF :=
  memStorInvP ms γs (memStorJ γ K)

def memStorJ (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) : MemJust GF :=
  { SV := snapshotValid γ, B := fun k => nodeAppliedLb γ K k, DL := nodeCommitLb γ K, SV_pers := ⋯, B_pers := ⋯,
    B_timeless := ⋯, DL_pers := ⋯ }

theorem memStorage_isStorage [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (wp_LastIndex :
    MemoryStorage.LastIndex.spec) (wp_FirstIndex : MemoryStorage.FirstIndex.spec) (wp_Term :
    MemoryStorage.Term.spec) (wp_Entries : MemoryStorage.Entries.spec) (wp_Snapshot :
    MemoryStorage.Snapshot.spec) (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) : ⊢
    memStorInv ms γs γ K -∗ memStorReg ms γs -∗ isStorage γ K (memStorIface ms)

theorem memStorInv_persistent (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) : Persistent
    (memStorInv ms γs γ K)

theorem memStorInv_alloc [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames)
    (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) (c : Nat) (sv : SnapshotM) (E : CoPset) : ⊢ memStorLock ms γs -∗
    memStorFresh ms γs c sv -∗ nodeAppliedLb γ K c -∗ ⌜sv.Metadata'.Index' = W64 0⌝ ∨ snapshotValid
    γ sv ∗ nodeCommitLb γ K (uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index') ={E}=∗ memStorInv ms γs γ K
